notes.title: Dustwind: Resistance - Out Now
notes.content: [p]Today is an important day for our dev studio. We self-publish a completely new game in the Dustwind universe. The Dustwind successor called [b]"Dustwind: Resistance"[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110370/Dustwind_Resistance/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Dustwind: Resistance is a real-time tactics game with pause functionality, set in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Players command a squad of warriors and a loyal dog named Diesel to fight back against a ruthless raider army. Using a mix of combat tools and skills—including stealth, traps, heavy weapons, turrets, or a massive armored car—players complete high-stakes missions to defend their home and secure their people’s freedom.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11009411/38bbe362b10fdeb13a0a7403174381ee6c94885b.png"][/img][/p]
